[WAIT] navigation settles

[WAIT] the order grid has rendered at least one row

--- SCREEN: Filter, Sort, Page ---

[WAIT] the grid re-renders filtered
[ACT] sort by Date
[WAIT] the grid re-renders sorted
[ACT] navigate to page 2 of the result
[WAIT] the grid re-renders page 2

[WAIT] the grid re-renders unfiltered
[ACT] return to page 1
[WAIT] page 1 renders
[ACT] open the row for @td(ORDER_REP_PLACED.number)

[WAIT] navigation settles on the order's destination page
[KEY] record the destination URL and the full set of enabled action controls
--- SCREEN: Return Via Breadcrumb ---
[ACT] click the customer segment of the breadcrumb
[WAIT] navigation settles
[KEY] record the resulting URL and whether the profile's Orders context is still active
